p. p. [गम्-क्त] 
__1 Gone, departed, gone for ever; [[
]]; किं गते सलिले सेतुबन्धेन, किं गते विवाहे नक्षत्रपरीक्षया [[

.]] ‘what is the use of locking the stable-door when the steed is stolen ?’ 
__2 Passed away, elapsed, past; गतायां रात्रौ. 
__3 Dead, deceased, departed to the next world; गत एव न ते निवर्तते [[

.]] 
__4 Gone to, arrived at, reaching to. 
__5 Being in, situated in, resting on, contained in; usually in comp.; प्रासादप्रान्तगतः [[

]] seated in the assembly; भर्तारं गता [[Ś. 4. 13]] united to a husband; so आद्य°; सर्वगत existing everywhere. 
__6 Fallen into, reduced to; e. g. आपद्गतः 
__7 Referring or relating to, with regard to, about, concerning, connected with (usually in comp.); राजा शकुन्तलागतमेब चिन्तयति [[Ś. 5]]; भर्तृगतया चिन्तया [[Ś. 4]]; वयमपि भवत्यौ सखीगतं किमपि पृच्छामः [[Ś. 1]]; so पुत्रगतः स्नेहः &c. 
__8 Frequented, resorted to; सुहृद्° [[

.]] 
__9 Known, celebrated. 
__10 Directed towards, belonging to. 
__11 Known, understood. 
-तम् 
__1 Motion, going; गतमुपरि घनानां वारिगर्भोदराणाम् [[Ś. 7. 7]]; [[Śi. 1. 2]], 7. 4. 
__2 Gait, manner of going; [[
]]; हंस प्रयच्छ मे कान्ता गतिरस्यास्त्वया हृता [[

.]] 
__3 An event. 
__4 The place where one has gone. 
__5 Celebration, being known, diffusion; यावन्नाम्नो गतम् [[Ch.

.]] 
__6 Manner. (As first member of comp. translated by ‘free from’, ‘bereft of’, ‘deprived of’, ‘without’.) 
-Comp. 
-अक्ष a. sightless, blind. 
-अध्वन् a. 
__1 one who has accomplished or finished a journey; बलैरध्युषितास्तस्य विजिगीषोर्गताध्वनः [[

]], 11. 33. 
__2 conversant, familiar (with anything); त्रिविधे मोक्षधर्मेऽस्मिन्गताध्बा छिन्नसंशयः [[

.]] (-f.) the time immediately preceding new moon when a small streak of the moon is still visible; (चतुर्दशीयुक्ताऽमावास्या). 
-अनुगतम् following custom or precedent. 
-अनुगतिक a. doing as others do, a blind follower; गतानुगतिको लोको न लोकः पारमार्थिकः [[
]] ‘people are blind followers or servile imitators’; [[

.]] 
-अन्त a. one whose end has arrived. 
-अर्थ a. 
__1 poor. 
__2 meaningless (the meaning [Page0649-1] being already expressed). 
-असु, -जीवित, -प्राण a. expired, dead; गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः [[

.]] 
-आगतम् 
__1 going and coming, frequent visits; आदित्यस्य गतागतैरहरहः संक्षीयते जीवितम् [[

]]; 4. 1. 
__2 interchange of place; कष्टं स्मरामि तव तानि गतागतानि [[

.]] 
__3 the flight of a bird backward and forward. 
__4 irregular course of the stars (in astronomy). 
__5 Narration of past and future; स सर्वमखिलं राज्ञो वंशस्याह गतागतम् [[

.]] 
-आधि a. free from anxiety, happy. 
-आयुस् a. decrepit, infirm, very old. 
-आर्तवा 
__1 a woman past her child-bearing. 
__2 a barren woman. 
-उत्साह a. disspirited, dejected. 
-ओजस् a. bereft of strength or energy. 
-कल्मष a. freed from crime or sin, purified. 
-क्लम a. refreshed; संविशेत्तु यथाकालमुत्तिष्ठेच्च गतक्लमः [[

.]] 
-चेतन a. deprived of sense or consciousness, insensible, senseless. 
-त्रप a. bold, without fear or shame; [[

.]] 
-दिनम्, -दिवसः the past day, yesterday. 
-दिनम् ind. yesterday. 
-प्रत्यागत a. returned after having gone away; [[

.]] 
-प्रभ a. bereft of splendour, dim, obscured, faded. 
-प्राण a. lifeless, dead. 
-प्राय a. almost gone, nearly passed away; गतप्राया रजनी. 
-भर्तृका 
__1 a widow. 
__2 (rarely) a woman whose husband has gone abroad (= प्रोषितभर्तृका); किमु मुहुर्मुहुर्गतभर्तृकाः [[Śi.]] 
-मनस्क a. thinking of (loc.); सपदि गतमनस्कः (प्रियायाः केशपाशे) [[

.]] 
-लक्ष्मीक a. 
__1 bereft of lustre or splendour, faded. 
__2 deprived of wealth, impoverished, suffering losses. 
-वयस्, -वयस्क a. advanced in years, aged, old; गतवयसामपि पुंसां येषामर्था भवन्ति ते तरुणाः [[

.]] 
-वर्षः, -र्षम् the past year. 
-वैर a. at peace (with), reconciled. 
-व्यथ a. free from pain; प्रत्तां दुहितरं सम्राट् सदृक्षाय गतव्यथः [[

.]] 
-शैशव a. past child-hood. 
-श्रम a. unmindful of troubles; आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य जगाम स गतश्रमः [[

.]] 
-सङ्ग a. 
__1 free from attachment; गतसङ्गस्य युक्तस्य [[

.]] 
__2 adverse or indifferent to. 
-सत्त्व a. 
__1 dead, annihilated, lifeless. 
__2 base. 
-सन्नकः an elephant out of rut. 
-स्पृह a. indifferent to worldly attachments; गतस्पृहो धैर्यधरः कृपालुः [[Vaidyajīvanam.]]

f. [गम्-भावे क्तिन्] 
__1 Motion, going, moving, gait; गतिर्विगलिता [[
]] do not mend their slow gait (do not mend their pace); so गगनगतिः [[

.]] 
__2 Access, entrance; मणौ वज्रसमुत्कीर्णे सूत्रस्येवास्ति मे गतिः [[

.]] 
__5 Going to, reaching, obtaining; वैकुण्ठीया गतिः [[

.]] 
__7 State, condition; दानं भोगो नाशस्तिस्रो गतयो भवन्ति वित्तस्य [[

.]] 
__8 Position, station, situation, mode of existence; परार्ध्यगतेः पितुः [[

]], 420. 
__9 A means, expedient, course, alternative; अनुपेक्षणे द्वयी गतिः [[
]]; का गतिः what help is there, can't help (often used in dramas) [[
]]; cf. also अगतिका हि एषा गतिः यत् कृत्स्नसंयोगे सति विकल्पसमुच्चयौ स्याताम् [[ŚB. on

.]] 
__10 Recourse, shelter, refuge, asylum, resort; विद्यमाना गतिर्येषाम् [[

]], 322; आसयत् सलिले पृथ्वीं यः स मे श्रीहरिर्गतिः [[Sk.]] 
__11 Source, origin, acquisition; क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति [[

.]] 
__12 A way, path. 
__13 A march, procession. 
__14 An event, issue, result. 
__15 The course of events, fate, fortune. 
__16 Course of asterisms. 
__17 The diurnal motion of a planet in its orbit. 
__18 A running wound or sore, fistula. 
__19 Knowing; अनेन पूर्वं न मयेति का गतिः [[

.]] 
__21 A stage or period of life (as शैशव, यौवन, वार्धक). 
__22 (In gram.) A term for prepositions and some other adverbial prefixes (such as अलम्, तिरस् &c.) when immediately connected with the tenses of a verb or verbal derivatives. 
__23 Position of a child at birth. 
-Comp. 
-अनुसरः following the course of another. 
-ऊन a. impassable, desert. 
-भङ्गः stoppage. 
-हीन a. without refuge, helpless, forlorn.

__1 Going, motion. 
__2 Course. 
__3 Condition, 
__4 Refuge, asylum.

a. 
__1 In motion, moving; गिरिरिव गतिमानपक्षलोपात् [[

.]] 
__2 Having running sores, fistulous. 
__3 Possessing means (such as wealth, books &c.); अगाधाश्चाप्रतिष्ठाश्च गतिमन्तश्च नारद [[

a. (-री f.) 
__1 Going, movable, locomotive; विग्रहायाग्रतः पश्चाद्गत्वरोरभ्रविभ्रमम् [[

]]; गत्वर्यो यौवनश्रियः 11. 12. 
__3 A kind of horse; गत्वरा साध्यवासाश्च सिन्धुदाराः कनीयसः [[Śālihotra]], Appendix II, 10.
a. (-की f.) Caused by going or coming.
a. (-की f.) Caused by blindly following or imitating custom or example.

__2 A singer. 
__3 A celestial chorister. 
__4 The male (Indian) cuckoo. 
__5 The large black bee. -Ved. 
__6 Going, motion; गातुं को अस्मिन् [[

.]] 
__7 Free place for moving. 
__8 The earth. 
__9 A refuge.

-त्रा The earth. 
-Comp. 
-अनुलेपनी a fragrant unguent applied to the body. 
-आवरणम् a shield; [[

.]] 
-कर्षण a. emaciating or weakening the body. 
-भङ्गः, -भञ्जनम् stretching one's limbs. 
-मार्जनी a towel. 
-यष्टिः f. a thin or slender body; रोमाञ्चलक्ष्येण स गात्रयष्टिं भित्त्वा निराकामदरालकेश्याः [[

.]] 
-रुहम् the hair on the body; नेत्रे जलं गात्ररुहेषु हर्षः [[

.]] 
-लता a thin or tender body, slim figure. 
-वेष्टनम् spasmodic sensation; [[

.]] 
-संकोचिन् m. the pole-cat; (so called because it contracts its body in order to spring); a hedgehog; cf. [[

.]] com. 
-संप्लवः a small bird, the diver.
a. To be sung; what may be sung.

a. (-त्री f.) [गै-गाने तृच्]
